Cross-dataset transfer is UNBC source to BioVid target, with neutral and generated target pain images used in target adaptation.

primary_method_review.reuse_access: BioVid and UNBC raw data are not freely downloadable under the paper's described routes; requests and, for UNBC, an access agreement are required.
